name: v0 by Vercel
what: Prompt-to-code builder for React apps and dashboards. A chat returns source files and a preview URL, accepts prompt or element-scoped edits, imports a Claude Design export as an editable code project, and deploys to Vercel. It writes application code. It is not a visual asset generator.
install: Attach the v0 connector in the host's connector settings, then sign in with the user's v0 account. When a call answers that the connection must be reconnected, the user reconnects it in the same settings.
firstCall: usage_getSummary (connection preflight and credit state); no init tool exists
evidenceNote: Tool schemas and server instructions read. The server was connected but its sign-in had lapsed: usage_getSummary and chats_list both answered that the connection must be reconnected. No live call succeeded. Every statement about credits, the generated stack, templates, import behavior and output quality is unverified.
